maddeler.e:
أتمئر (form IVq)
# أَتْمَئِرُّ (ʔatmaʔirru) /ʔat.ma.ʔir.ru/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِتْمَأَرَّ (itmaʔarra)
# أَتْمَئِرَّ (ʔatmaʔirra) /ʔat.ma.ʔir.ra/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِتْمَأَرَّ (itmaʔarra)
# أَتْمَئِرِّ (ʔatmaʔirri) /ʔat.ma.ʔir.ri/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِتْمَأَرَّ (itmaʔarra)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
